definitions.short: a knob or belaying-pin (from its swelling form)
definitions.full: H7165. qeres [ קֶ֫רֶס ] noun [masculine] hook , on edge of curtains of tabernacle, matching the loops ( לֻלָאֹת , see [ לוּלַי ]); plural קְרָסִים Exod 26:6 , 11 = 36:13 , 18 ; 26:33 ; construct זָהָב קַרְסֵי 26:6 = 36:13 , ׳ק נְחשֶׁת 26:11 = 36:18 ; suffix קְרָסָיו 35:11 = 39:33 .
